title: Hold a driller's licence
what: Do bore work only under a driller's licence.

sources.title: Water Resources Act 2007 (ACT)
sources.locator: s 33 (current republication (R29, from 26 November 2025; Water Resources Act 2007 | Acts))
sources.quote: A person must not do bore work if the person does not have a driller’s licence to do the bore work

administration.note: The Water Resources Act 2007 calls it 'the authority'; its note to s 69 points to the Environment Protection Act 1997, s 14(2).
